propositions: Plan review operations that reach PASS verdict must sign and persist a plan-review attestation by default at every public mutating entry point (CLI review-plan and library review_plan) unless explicitly opted out
Deliberate unsigned execution requires explicit opt-out: --no-sign flag for CLI, sign=False parameter for library use
BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded, and explicitly unsigned results must never receive a signed attestation; signing guards must be enforced at the shared finalization seam
Re-running a plan review with a current claim-valid attestation must reuse it idempotently without LLM call or duplicate signature event
Signature persistence failures on PASS verdicts must return a retryable nonzero disposition and identify sign-review as the recovery path
CLI help and documentation must clearly state the sign-by-default contract, explicit opt-out syntax, non-signable verdicts, and recovery behavior
